english_text: Commissioner , I appreciate your answer and your effort generally regarding the environment in Europe , but what you say is simply not coherent with everyday facts . When this was implemented in Finland it was mainly based on old protection schemes , which do not meet directive criteria for Natura 2000 sites . Therefore , you must understand the position of the private landowners . Their right to use their own land was wrongly prohibited and in fact , contrary to what you say , the appeals in the Finnish courts were handled en bloc . 99 times out of 100 they were rejected outright . People therefore feel frustrated and powerless .
